attribute.name: Flow
attribute.text: Acrobatics, soft martial arts, evasion, seamless movement.

attribute.name: Precision
attribute.text: Marksmanship, aimed hits on weak points, fine work.

attribute.name: Force
attribute.text: Brute destruction, physical strength, unstoppable attacks.

attribute.name: Instinct
attribute.text: Reflexes, sensing danger, acting on gut feeling.

attribute.name: Focus
attribute.text: Tactics, analytical thinking, deduction, logical reasoning.

legendaerePreise.name: Burnt Out
legendaerePreise.text: No more Momentum gain for the rest of the scene.

legendaerePreise.name: Scar
legendaerePreise.text: Permanent tag or lasting injury (e.g. wrist, eyesight).

legendaerePreise.name: Recoil
legendaerePreise.text: The user suffers an injury themselves.

legendaerePreise.name: Overextension
legendaerePreise.text: Mastery drops by 2 until the next rest.

legendaerePreise.name: Lockout
legendaerePreise.text: The move is only available again after training/downtime.

legendaerePreise.name: Charging Up
legendaerePreise.text: The user is exposed for one round (opponents get +2 against them) before the move goes off.

legendaerePreise.name: Revelation
legendaerePreise.text: All opponents know the move and prepare for it.

legendaerePreise.name: Collateral Damage
legendaerePreise.text: The surroundings, civilians or allies are put in danger.

legendaerePreise.name: Loss
legendaerePreise.text: A weapon or piece of gear breaks.
